The bridge is a plugin of aicore.ext.plugins with id workspace-planner and point workspace:plans-migrator; the call needs [aicore.plugins.workspace-planner] in the config (aicore.ext.plugins.find_registration). The bridge is not added to configs/install-profiles.json (planner-orch is not there either). apply answers refusals as output.result == 'refused' with code, message, phase (status ok), not as a protocol error.

summary: Bridge bridges/workspace-planner (kind bridge, port workspace:plans-migrator, plugin migrator.py, timeout 3600 s) with inspect, apply and verify. inspect classifies <root>/plans (v4, legacy, derived left out, top-level files, symlinks, items in progress) and gives a sha256 manifest. apply is the critical section W2-W5: migration lock, PlanLock of all v4 plans in sorted path order (MIGRATION_LOCKED releases the taken ones), digest recheck, per-folder decision (copied, skipped-equal, imported-copy, kept-workspace, MIGRATION_CONFLICT), copy2 into .staging/<op_id> with digest checks, staged plans loaded and checked, os.rename, marker plans_store=workspace written last; a failure before the rename removes the staging folder and leaves the marker alone; a repeat after rename-without-marker only writes the marker; a repeat after a full migration is noop. verify loads plans through the planner store and compares (code, where) error sets with a baseline. Contract schemas request/response added at packages/workspace/schemas/plans-migrator/v1 and registered in packages/workspace/unit.json. 63 bridge tests cover classes, derived files, digests, symlinks, locks and waiting, PLANS_MIGRATED, injected failures, resume, import modes and the plugin protocol.
